Primary accent #A4C970; balance it with warm ivory, charcoal and physically appropriate material colors. The accent organizes large color masses; do not recolor every surface uniformly. Physically dimensional rounded sculpting, deliberately designed proportions, asymmetric silhouettes, specific expressive faces where appropriate, hand-shaped imperfections. Framing: entire subject and all connected props visible, one compact self-contained artful silhouette centered inside a square image with at least 8% genuinely transparent safety margins on EVERY side. Clear big forms readable at 64px, rich selective craftsmanship at 160–300px, one visual focal point. A narrow opaque warm ivory die-cut edge tightly follows the irregular silhouette, subtle tight edge shadow. No rectangular background, floor plane, scenery extending to the edge, display plinth unrelated to the subject, card bitmap, indices, suit symbols, lettering, numerals, signs, logos or watermark. Avoid SVG/icon-pack aesthetics, generic humanoid templates, repeated standing characters holding different props, generic clipart, cluttered confetti, diffuse smoky effects and photorealism.
